source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 row 77 named the Quaternius Worker from the Animated Characters (24-clip rig) set on poly.pizza, now behind a Cloudflare challenge. Substituted with Worker_Male from the Quaternius Ultimate Animated Character Pack (Nov 2019) on OpenGameArt (same zip and pin as man-casual and adventurer): the same character concept (hard hat, vest over a T-shirt, shorts). It ships 11 clips (idle, walk, punch, hit, sit, walk-carry, pick-up, one-handed shoot, victory, defeat, stand-up), not 24: no run, jump, death or gun idles. The source vest is brown and the hat dull gold; both are painted festival amber here so the hard hat and hi-vis read at a glance.
